help.short: The filter to apply on the operation. For more information please see https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/rest/api/apimanagement/apis?redirectedfrom=MSDN

description: List the current availability status for impacted resources in the subscription.

operations.description: Lists the current availability status for impacted resources in the subscription.

params.description: Subscription credentials which uniquely identify Microsoft Azure subscription. The subscription ID forms part of the URI for every service call.
params.name: subscriptionId

params.description: The filter to apply on the operation. For more information please see https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/rest/api/apimanagement/apis?redirectedfrom=MSDN
params.name: $filter

props.description: The URI to fetch the next page of impactedResourceStatus.
props.name: nextLink

props.description: Fully qualified resource ID for the resource. Ex - /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/{resourceProviderNamespace}/{resourceType}/{resourceName}
props.name: id

props.description: Impacted resource status of the resource.
props.name: availabilityState

props.description: Timestamp for when last change in health status occurred.
props.name: occuredTime

props.description: When the resource's availabilityState is Unavailable, it describes where the health impacting event was originated.
props.name: reasonType

props.description: Summary description of the impacted resource status.
props.name: summary

props.description: Title description of the impacted resource status.
props.name: title

props.description: The type of the resource. E.g. "Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines" or "Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts"
props.name: type

responses.description: The list of current availability status for impacted resources in the subscription
